notes.title: Playtest available till end of March
notes.content:
As part of Feedback Quest 6, we have made our Playtest available again!

This playtest will be available until the end of March, so do try it out and let us know what you think!

Playtest-only changes:

 During the game (outside of the farm), you can now change the camera angle! To do so, you can use the right joystick on the gamepad, or right-click and drag the mouse. The camera angle is not currently saved across levels.
 There are 3 campaign levels available in the playtest, which completes the first story beat of the campaign.
 Besides Peppermint and Vanilla, Honey the loving dog is also available as a playable character in the campaign (if you unlock her).
 Eclair is a new shop NPC that you may encounter in the campaign, and she offers unique buffs you can purchase with coins.
 The Lunar New Year level is disabled for this playtest. If you wish to play that level, you can do so through our demo.
 We have not completed translations / localization for the new campaign levels, so please do not switch languages during the playtest.


Other changes:

 Levels can now have alternate objectives, i.e., Do A or B. You may encounter one of more of these in the campaign.
 Player buffs (e.g., damage, speed, defense etc) are now unique across campaign playthroughs. Coins earned from all games (including classic mode) are cumulative, so any coins you earn anywhere will help future playthroughs.
 Wolves, being smarter than foxes, now jump in front of the player's position.


Bug fixes

 Fixed a bug where newly-spawned creatures would run away at the beginning of a level

notes.title: Game balancing for campaign
notes.content:
We've balanced the difficulty of the campaign levels. Our general philosophy for difficulty levels is: for the Spicy (Medium) difficulty, new players should be able to complete it without dying, but it may feel a little challenging at times. For veteran players of the genre, Feisty (Hard) difficulty should be more your style! The Cozy (Easy) difficulty is for players who seldom/never play similar games, and would like to enjoy the game without worrying (too much) about dying.

{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/ed00f88fcaebba63ceb13905ec4c08adf6ccf41e.gif

If you find the game too easy/difficult, please experiment with the 3 difficulty modes and also the sliders! The sliders allow you to customize different aspects of the game's difficulty, ranging from the number of enemies, to their heath, their damage, attack speed, and so on!

As always, we would love to hear your feedback about the game! Please post to our Steam discussion board, about anything and everything, including which difficulty mode you like, or which custom setting you feel fits you best!

Changes:

 The difficulty for the campaign levels have been balanced. Overall it should be slightly more difficult, with more enemies spawning that are easier to kill and give less experience. Loot drop rates have also similarly been adjusted.
 Damage for lightning bolts have been significantly reduced.
 The graphics for "Feisty Fauna" text in the menus have been updated.
 Minor improvements to the UI for classic/co-op game mode have been made.

notes.title: Beta playtest
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/ca49736b35e4a07b0070b924884530d4b8187e01.png

We have launched our beta playtest! Thanks to those of you who have signed up 😊 Please try out the playtest version, and let us know what you think!

This beta playtest version is in active development, so bugs probably do exist. We are very keen to hear about any bugs that you encounter, so do let us know!

If you're interested to participate in the playtest, please click "Request access" above, and you should be granted access immediately. Our playtest is set to "Open" so all requests are automatically approved.

The playtest version doesn't have all the features of the beta yet (we're still developing some of them), but it does have the following:

 Multiplayer (local co-op and online with Steam Remote play-together)
 More skills to choose from
 A boss fight after the 3 minibosses
 Customizable difficulty
 and more!


Please give it a try and let us know what you think on the Steam Discussion Board.

notes.title: Beta version coming soon!
notes.content:
{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/42014435/8e987df348fc583a3288f2e22bc381003abd29d1.gif

We are hard at work preparing for the beta launch of Feisty Fauna! We will be releasing many new features, including:

 split-screen multiplayer (up to 4 players, local / Steam remote play-together)
 cat ninja minions for Vanilla
 many more skills
 customizable difficulty, so you can adjust the game to be just right for you
 damage-over-time effects (e.g., burning from fire)
 better telegraphing of attacks (e.g., a circle filling up with red)

and more!

As part of our beta launch, we will be removing the following from our demo:

 Halloween world and costumes (don't worry, they'll be back later this year!)


Going forward from our beta launch, here are some of the big features we're planning to incorporate soon:

 Honey will be playable and can charm enemies to join her side
 A roll/dodge mechanic that you can manually activate (or automatically if you prefer)
 Other status effects, e.g., freezing, slime


Do let us know (e.g., through the Steam Discussion Board) if there are any big features that you're looking forward to seeing, and/or if you're interested to playtest our beta version before it's launched!

notes.title: Alpha demo released!
notes.content:
The Alpha version of our demo is now available, please give it a try and let us know what you think!

Features:

 Play as Vanilla, the cat ninja

 Earn coins in-game for meta-progression
 Complete 4 mini-levels, with 3 mini-bosses and 1 final boss stage
